definition.label: Strongly regularized shallow LightGBM residual on fixed V25 logits
definition.error_basis: Standalone tree experts are weaker but offer some complementarity; fit only a small additive logit correction, rather than replacing Kumo or fitting a large full-risk model
definition.formula: eta=eta_V25+.15*clip(tree_raw_margin,-.5,.5);80 depth2 LightGBM trees trained with init_score=eta_V25
